name: Agno
description: Framework and runtime for agent platforms: build agents with the SDK, serve them through AgentOS and manage them in a web UI.
whatItDoes: Gives teams a self-owned agent stack with a REST API for serving agents, a Postgres store for data and traces and a control plane. Starter templates (for Docker, Railway, AWS and others) bring up a working platform locally.
howItWorks: Agents are written with the Agno SDK and hosted by the AgentOS runtime, which exposes an API and an MCP server. The README directs users to clone a starter template repo and run it with Docker.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: The starter templates run the platform locally in Docker
